title: Xinyuan Liu — CS PhD Student, Arizona State University | LLM Evaluation and Routing, Humanoid Robotics, Embodied AI
description: Xinyuan Liu is a computer science PhD student at Arizona State University (LENS Lab), advised by Ransalu Senanayake. She works on information-efficient AI systems: online LLM selection and routing, cognitive evaluation of humanoid robots, LLM orchestration of multi-robot systems, and imitation learning for embodied agents.
alumni_of: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
research_focus: Online LLM selection and routing from limited preference feedback
Cognitive and human-factors evaluation of humanoid robots
LLM orchestration of multi-robot crews with enforced execution contracts
Imitation learning and behavior cloning for embodied agents
Multimodal learning for surgical and medical systems
